decisions.executionNote: Begin a symmetric, elbow-continuous approach, pitching both grippers toward the tabletop to position behind the straightedge.
Retry with substantially smaller pitch and translation increments after the continuity rejection; neither arm moved previously.
Bring closed grippers inward and continue pitching down while staying behind the ruler and clear of the cubes.
Continue the guarded downward pitch, moving to separated contact positions near each end of the straightedge.
Rotate in place toward a vertical pushing posture, with both arms remaining on their own sides.
Finish rotating the closed grippers downward before making a low, controlled two-point push.
Advance both closed fingertips toward the near edge of the ruler, retaining vertical orientation and a wide two-point stance.
Begin the low two-point sweep. The left tip is nearer the skewed ruler; advancing both should square it before it reaches the blocks.
The ruler is now visually straight. Sweep it toward the staggered blocks, gently matching the right contact height and forward position to the left.
Continue a level, slow sweep so the straightedge reaches all three cubes without grasping or lifting them.
All cubes are contacting the ruler; extend the gentle sweep to let the still-rotated right cube settle flush with the other two.
The three blocks now appear flush and parallel in a straight row. Back both empty grippers away from the ruler with slight clearance to begin resetting.
Withdraw and unwind the wrist pitch along a continuous return path; open the empty grippers while leaving the aligned blocks undisturbed.
Continue toward the recorded home poses with small coordinated translation and pitch changes; the blocks remain visibly aligned.
Continue the gradual return to origin with both elbows following the established configuration.
Approach the original arm positions gradually while keeping the ruler and completed row untouched.
Slow the final approach to the original open-gripper posture, preserving joint continuity near the home configuration.
